articleTitle: The Application of Generative AI Technology in ESP Courses for Civil Engineering Majors
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: English writing proficiency undoubtedly stands as a crucial metric in assessing students’ English ability. It not only mirrors their vocabulary accrual and grammatical proficiency but also underscores their logical thinking, cultural awareness, and innovative capabilities. However, the challenge in elevating English writing skills stems from both students’ learning attitudes and habits, as well as teachers’ teaching methods and ideologies. To address these obstacles, generative artificial intelligence has been harnessed to fuel a series of teaching reform initiatives, particularly within the realm of English for specific purposes. In order to cultivate greater enthusiasm and proficiency in writing among students, a quasi-experimental teaching study was conducted for a semester among undergraduate civil engineering students. The research findings have shown that the integration of ERNIE Bot 4.0 in ESP courses significantly enhances students’ English writing proficiency and effectively sparks their enthusiasm for writing.

articleTitle: Application of Data Mining and Analysis Techniques in the China Biographical Database (CBDB)
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: Data mining and analysis techniques hold significant importance in the construction and application within relational databases, highlighting substantial advancements in integrating technology with scientific research methodologies. This paper primarily investigates three major technical developments. First, the use of VS Code for data vectorization training provides “templates” for neural network models, facilitating the automation of data extraction. Second, by utilizing QGIS technology, vector spatial analysis is conducted on specific groups to further interpret geographic data information in depth; third, using GEPHI, the influence tension of character relationships is quantified through GEPHI with degree centrality as the core indicator, to perform social network analysis on specific groups, thereby understanding the mechanisms of information transmission and the diffusion of influence. Through these technical approaches, this study offers valuable insights into the construction of relational databases, providing comprehensive recommendations for data extraction, spatial analysis, and social network analysis.

articleTitle: Granularity Statistical Invariants Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: Learning using statistical invariants (LUSI) is a new paradigm in machine learning, which aims to effectively handle classification problems by utilizing weak convergence mechanisms. However, despite the wide applicability demonstrated by LUSI in handling classification tasks, training large-scale datasets poses computational challenges due to the high cost of computing invariant matrices in invariant learning. Although there have been recent improvements in related research, they are still not comprehensive enough. Therefore, this paper extends it to other statistical invariant learning mechanisms in Hilbert space, resulting in a more comprehensive granularity statistical invariant learning model, namely granularity statistical invariant learning (GSIL). Finally, experimental validation demonstrates that GSIL effectively resolves the storage and computation issues of the V -matrix classification method, while also enhancing the generalization capability, particularly exhibiting significant advantages in nonlinear spaces.

articleTitle: Application of PCB Strain Testing in Micro-inertial Measurement Unit MEMS
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: This article uses the Wheatstone bridge principle to build a system for testing tiny deformations on the PCB board of MEMS components. This study shows that PCB strain testing can optimize the stress tolerance of micro-inertial measurement MEMS during assembly and use, thereby ensuring the system accuracy of MEMS and improving the reliability of electronic components. Through the research of this article, it is found that when the micro-inertial measurement unit MEMS is assembled, the maximum principal strain is 27.5με, and the direction is the vertical screw installation direction and parallel to the mechanical backing surface of the MEMS installation shell. When the temperature is lower than −20°C or the temperature is higher than 50°C, the MEMS assembly stress deteriorates significantly.

articleTitle: Construction and Application of C University Resource Evaluation Model Based on Neural Network Perspective
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: This study takes University C as an example to establish a resource performance evaluation model by setting resource evaluation indicators. The neural network method is used to determine the relationship between resource input and output of each college of University C, and the cluster ranking results of input and output two-dimensional data based on specific clustering standards are used. With the goal of minimizing deviation, genetic algorithm is used to optimize model parameters and build the optimal performance evaluation model.

articleTitle: 3D Face Reconstruction Algorithm Based on Lightweight Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: 3D face reconstruction has significant research value in computer vision sector. This technic was widely applied in multiple areas, such as virtual try-on, E-commerce live streaming, anti-proofing and animation. But reconstructing by traditional algorithms may affected by facial expression, occlusion and ambient light that can cause poor reconstruction accuracy and robustness. As artificial intelligence developing fast, deep learning was more and more used in computer vision sector. That provides various possibilities in optimizing of 3D face reconstruction algorithms.. We developed a three-dimensional face reconstruction algorithm based on light attention proposed in this thesis. The algorithm adds face mask input and channel attention mechanism to the preprocessing part and the network structure part respectively, and uses a lightweight module in the network structure part. The algorithm greatly reduces the number of parameters of the algorithm model, improves the reconstruction speed and reconstruction effect, and has strong practicability.

articleTitle: An AHP-Based Defect Detection Algorithm Study for E-paper Pockmarks Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: Pockmarks detection in electronic paper (e-paper) mannfactnring plays a crucial role since pockmarks defects compromise the clarity of the e-paper. Current vision-based pockmarks defect detection methods can only be applied to specific models of e-paper and particular types of pockmarks defects. They lack the ability to adjust detection accuracy in response to product models. Aiming at these issues, this paper proposes a pockmarks defect detection model based on the AHP algorithm. The hierarchical analysis model constructed based on the AHP algorithm quantifies the characteristics of pockmarks defects and integrates the hierarchical detection model. Specifically, we first clearly define the product batch to be inspected and the grade standards for inspection. Then, we quantify the detection indicators of pockmarks defects using the AHP algorithm. Finally, we verify the conformity of the detection results by testing them on a machine. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed AHP-based Jockmarks detection algorithm realizes free adjustment of detection accuracy. It can detect more than ten types of e-paper defects, including pockmarks defects, with a detection accuracy of over 95%.

articleTitle: Design And Implementation of Intelligent Power Controller for Distribution Automation Terminal
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: The reliability of the power supply system directly affects the reliability of the distribution automation system. In response to the high reliability and easy maintenance requirements of the distribution automation terminal for power supply, this paper designs an intelligent power controller. The device adopts a modular design, mainly composed of MCU module, AC power management module, battery management module, supercapacitor management module, voltage sampling module and output power switch module. The software design uses an independent operating system for multitasking synchronous execution, ensuring fast response to tasks and stable operation. The intelligent power controller can measure, calculate and judge the key voltage, so as to realize intelligent energy scheduling, intelligent charge management, intelligent power supply control and other functions. It has the advantages of strong dynamic output ability, stable and reliable operation, visible state and intelligent controllability, and effectively improves the operational reliability of distribution automation terminal.

articleTitle: Based on the Design of Smart Air Screen Skipping Rope Products
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: Rope skipping is a traditional sports activity in China and an emerging program in the new curriculum. In order to solve the problems of unable to view the data in real time, the risk of injury and the lack of fun in jumping rope, an intelligent air screen jump rope is designed. The jump rope utilizes the principle of human visual residual, through the LED display and algorithm control, it can show the data in real time during the movement. The chip calculates the speed of jumping rope, and the sensor detects the angle of the handheld, which reminds and corrects the wrong action in time to avoid knee injury. This not only improves the fun of jumping rope, but also makes the exercise safer and more effective. The jump rope is integrated with holographic display and posture detection, which can help to cultivate the fitness habit of all the people.

articleTitle: Decay Estimates for the Magnetic Zakharov System in 3 Dimensions
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: We obtain the decay estimates for the solutions of the magnetic Zakharov system. articleTitle: Pedestrian Flow Monitoring System for Commercial Areas Based on Deep Learning and QT
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: This paper investigates the multi-target detection and system implementation problems of pedestrian flow for commercial areas. First, a deep network is trained based on the PaddleDetection framework and the FairMOT model, and it is fine-tuned for the scenarios of small, multi-target, and high-density targets to improve the accuracy of pedestrian flow counting. Then, an approach to estimate pedestrian density by setting predefined values is proposed. In terms of system implementation, it is developed using C++ language and QT framework, which uses OpenCV to capture the video stream and analyze and process the pedestrian flow in the frame images. In addition, the system is designed with some useful features such as historical pedestrian flow graphs and over limit alarms.

articleTitle: Research on Strawberry Disease Detection Method Based on YOLOv7 CNeB Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: In today’s agricultural production and plant disease management, accurate and efficient identification and classification of plant diseases is crucial. With the rapid development of artificial intelligence and machine learning technology, the use of these advanced technologies to improve the accuracy and efficiency of disease identification has become a research hotspot. Traditional disease identification methods rely on expert experience and knowledge, but this method has limitations when dealing with large-scale data and complex conditions. Therefore, the development of an automatic disease identification and classification system based on deep learning can significantly improve the efficiency and accuracy of disease management, which is of great significance for ensuring agricultural production and reducing economic losses.

articleTitle: Kinematics Analysis of Delta Parallel Robot Based on Numerical Solutions Method
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: Kinematics analysis of parallel robot is very important to accurately grasp its working range and trajectory planning. The inverse kinematics solution is relatively simple, but the forward kinematics solution is generally more complicated. In this paper, a 3-DOF Delta parallel robot prototype is put forward and its kinematic model is established and analyzed. The solution process of the kinematics is completely derived by numerical method, and the constraint conditions are applied in MATLAB program to determine the unique solution. Finally, based on the forward kinematics solution model and Monte Carlo method, the working area is simulated by using MATLAB software. By comparing the parameters of the robot’s motion range, the rationality of the model is verified, laying the foundation for subsequent research on the robot’s motion trajectory and interference conditions under various working conditions.

articleTitle: Study on Optimization of Power Frequency Electric Field Exceeding the Standard of Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: The influence of electromagnetic pollution caused by high-voltage power transmission and transformation equipment on cities and residents living near power transmission lines and substations for a long time has attracted the attention of all sectors of society. Governing the electromagnetic environment of transmission line corridors and optimizing the power frequency electric field can reduce people’s unnecessary panic about power grid construction. Based on the above background, this paper studies the optimization method of spatial electric field distribution in the vicinity of transmission lines and surrounding buildings, puts forward the improvement method of electric field distribution, analyzes and compares various erection methods of shielded wire, and puts forward the optimal scheme of shielded wire erection.

articleTitle: Application of Computer Image Processing Technology in Visualizing Rock Microstructure
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: With the rapid development of computer technology, image processing technology has become an indispensable tool for microstructure analysis. Especially, it plays an important role in improving the visualization quality and analysis accuracy of rock microstructure. In this study, the computer image processing software Avizo 2020.1 was used to perform a series of image processing operations on the collected rock sample WD9-1, including de-noising processing, threshold segmentation, contrast adjustment, watershed algorithm segmentation, etc. Based on this, a three-dimensional model was accurately constructed to comprehensively observe the pore structure of the internal rock, and the required rock attribute data were further extracted and analysed. The research results show the core role of computer image processing technology in the visualization of refined rock microstructure and its analysis, which provides strong technical support for geological exploration and oil and gas field development in actual production, and lays the foundation for the subsequent exploration of rock physical properties.

articleTitle: A Real Time Estimation Method of Road Adhesion Conditions based on PSO-Recursive Least Squares
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: In order to improve the safety and stability of vehicle braking, the optimal slip rate estimation problem for anti lock braking control strategy was analyzed. The principle of road adhesion condition estimation was analyzed, and the parameters of the Burckhardt model were linearized using exponential polynomials. The optimization process of particle swarm optimization for the preset parameters of the exponential polynomial model was studied. Based on the optimal preset parameters, the recursive least squares method was used to fit the estimated parameters of the exponential polynomial model, achieving estimation of road adhesion conditions. Amesim simulation results show that the estimation error of this method is within ± 10% under various road conditions.

Author Keywords: Particle swarm optimization. Recursive least squares

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Radant Lens Test
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: Radant lens radar can form the linear phase gradient required for beam scanning, completing one-dimensional phase scanning. It is composed of many parallel metal plates, multiple layers of dielectric between the plates, and many parallel diodes in the same direction in each layer of dielectric To ensure the accuracy of the phase shift value, all diodes need to work properly. The number of lenses on a single array can reach several thousand, and the problem of how to conduct testing urgently needs to be solved. This article adopts a digital approach to design a lens testing board and software development” which can conveniently and quickly solve lens testing problems.

articleTitle: Emotional analysis in human-computer interaction based on BP neural network algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: In addition to students’ cognitive processes, language learning also includes students’ emotional responses. Emotional factors have a positive role in promoting students’ language learning ability. Language expression contains personal emotions, grasps the emotional factors of oral language, designs a suitable teaching atmosphere, and promotes students’ oral language learning ability through oral communication. It has become unrealistic to use traditional manual judgment of the emotional tendencies contained in speech. Therefore, it is necessary to automatically analyze speech signals through technologies such as machine learning and deep neural networks. In recent years, speech signal feature analysis based on BP neural network method has been widely used in other fields. Based on this, this paper takes the spoken language expressed by students in human-computer dialogue of higher vocational students as the research object to build an emotion analysis model based on BP neural network, determine the evaluation indicators and weights through the analytic hierarchy process, and finally provide measures to be taken in daily teaching to improve the oral learning ability of higher vocational students.

articleTitle: Real-time Data Processing and Analysis in Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: In the context of the continuous transformation of the global energy structure and the development of smart grid technology, the stability and efficiency of power system operation become very important. The research objective of this thesis is to discuss the role of real-time data processing and analysis in enhancing the performance of power systems. This paper elaborates on the basic theory and key technologies of real-time data processing, which mainly involves data acquisition, transmission and communication technologies, and takes a large-scale power transmission and distribution enterprise as an example to analyze the specific application of real-time data processing technologies for monitoring, fault detection, load forecasting, and optimal scheduling. The study shows that the realization of these technologies significantly improves the data processing speed, shortens the fault response time, and improves the overall reliability and economic efficiency of the system.

articleTitle: Improved SqueezeNet-Based Method for Automotive Paint Film Defect Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: To address the issues of lacking datasets and low recognition accuracy for paint film defects, this paper proposes a denoising diffusion implicit model (DDIM) for data augmentation of paint film defects and innovatively suggests a classification method combining Selective Kernel Networks (SKNet) with SqueezeNet model. Initially, the DDIM is used for dataset expansion, followed by an evaluation of the similarity between generated and captured paint film defect images using multiscale structural similarity (MS-SSIM). The training and generation effects of DDIM are then compared with those of DCGAN. In the SqueezeNet model, a Selective Kernel module is added following the fire7 module to enhance the model’s attention mechanism. The results show that all types of paint film defect images generated by DDIM have MS-SSIM indices above 0.64, with most exceeding 0.7. The combined approach of Selective Kernel Networks(SKNet) and SqueezeNet outperforms other attention mechanisms, achieving an accuracy above 96.3%. The method demonstrates promising prospects for paint film defect detection, enhancing identification efficiency and accuracy while reducing detection costs, and is applicable to mobile or embedded devices.

articleTitle: Accurate Disassembly of ARMv8-A: Design and Implementation of a High-Fidelity Disassembler
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: ARMv8-A architecture processors are widely used in high-performance computing, servers, network equipment and scenarios that support large-scale data processing due to their flexibility, low power consumption and high performance. In order to solve the problem of inaccurate existing disassembly tools, this thesis designed and implemented an ARMv8-A disassembler to support the disassembly of three instruction sets: A64, A32 and T32 under the ARMv8-A architecture. The disassembler first collects 9030 valid instructions to implement the function of extracting instruction type decoding information and instruction format information, and then uses the instruction decoder to realize the functions of instruction type decoding and instruction format matching, and finally solves the problem of storing hundreds of millions of undefined instructions through the result exporter. In this thesis, we demonstrate that the constructed ARMv8-A disassembler is more consistent with the results in the ARMv8-A manual than the existing Capstone disassembler by doing accuracy comparison tests.

articleTitle: LiteDiT: An Efficient Diffusion Transformer Model for Remote Sensing Image Synthesis Focus on Object
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: In the domain of remote sensing image generation, existing diffusion models generate remote sensing image absence specific objects, furthermore training and sampling process require substantial computational resources. Addressing this challenge, we propose a more efficient diffusion transformer model via self-attention distillation, drastically reducing the number of parameters. Our approach focuses on generating the target areas with the efficient model and subsequently employs the image out-painting method to complete the surrounding background. This two-stage generation strategy ensures both the high quality and richness of details in the target regions while significantly enhancing the overall image generation speed and efficiency for remote sensing image.

articleTitle: Application research of super-efficiency DEA method in investment efficiency evaluation of power grid enterprises
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: Scientific evaluation of the development and operational efficiency of power grid enterprises can clarify the development status of the power grid, promote the improvement of the power grid structure, and achieve the improvement of energy utilization efficiency. This article takes H power grid enterprise as the research object. Based on the analysis of the development status of the power grid, the super-efficient DEA model is used to evaluate the development and operational efficiency of H power grid enterprise from multiple perspectives. Finally, based on the evaluation results, suggestions for power grid planning and development are proposed.

articleTitle: The Parameter Optimization Design of Self Disturbance Rejection Controller for Boost Converter Based on Particle Swarm Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: In order to improve the output voltage control characteristics of Boost converter and the anti-interference ability when the load changes suddenly, this paper proposes a single voltage loop control strategy based on Active Disturbance Rejection Controller (ADRC), in order to effectively improve the anti-interference ability of the converter. However, due to the difficulty in parameter tuning of ADRC controller in practical application, the application of ADRC controller in Boost converter is limited. Therefore, in this paper, particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to optimize the parameters of ADRC controller in the closed-loop control system of Boost converter. The algorithm randomly generates a certain number of particles in a certain range, and judges the quality of particles by the value of fitness function, which can quickly find the optimal controller parameters under the given performance index, which greatly improves the efficiency and control effect of parameter tuning compared with manual setting. Matlab/Simulink simulation results show that using particle swarm optimization to optimize the parameters of ADRC not only effectively improves the anti-load mutation interference ability of Boost converter, but also improves the efficiency of parameter setting, and has excellent application value.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Face Recognition Attendance System Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: PyCharm offers a suite of tools that help users write code quickly, find and fix bugs quickly, test quickly, and deploy applications quickly. Based on this, the design of face recognition attendance system, and can effectively face recognition attendance sign.

articleTitle: Improved Tea Detection Based on Yolov8
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: With the rapid development of deep learning technology, deep learning-based object detection algorithms have made remarkable progress in the field of image processing, which has the advantages of high accuracy, high robustness and high efficiency. In this study, we are committed to applying deep learning object detection technology to the detection and recognition of young tea leaves. On the basis of synthesizing the research status at home and abroad, and based on the YOLOv8 algorithm, a young tea leaf detection model based on improved YOLOv8 was proposed. In this study, the key aspects of data processing, model design, training process, and experimental setup are described in detail, and experimental simulations and results analysis are carried out to compare the performance of different models and optimize the models. The final results show that the tea young leaf detection algorithm based on the improved YOLOv8 has achieved significant improvement in detail detection and detection accuracy, and shows a high degree of detection accuracy and robustness. The research results are of great significance for tea production and quality control, and are expected to improve the detection efficiency and accuracy of young tea leaves, and contribute to the development of the tea industry.

articleTitle: Research on RFID Location-aware Technology in Internet of Things Application
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: Radio frequency technology is one of the key technologies of the perception layer of the Internet of Things (IoT), and it is also one of the research hotspots of the IoT technology. The paper focuses on the discussion and research of location information sensing technology based on RFID. The paper introduces the basic concept, basic composition and working principle of RFID technology. The relationship between RFID positioning technology and IoT and its advantages in IoT application scenarios are discussed. In addition, the paper introduces four common RFID location awareness algorithms and their principles. Finally, several typical IoT application scenarios based on RFID positioning technology are analyzed, including intelligent parking based on RFID location awareness technology, intelligent warehouse management, indoor personnel behavior analysis, intelligent workshop production and smart supermarket.

articleTitle: True Cause analysis of Turbocharger Intake Side Flange Leakage based on Computer-aided Engineering
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: For a certain type of direct injection turbocharged engine turbine inlet end compressed air outlet flange and inlet hard pipe flange combination surface leakage problem, finally through CAE simulation means, reproduce the flange combination surface in the engine work deformation and the sealing of the paper gasket, and ultimately to find the real reason for the leakage of the real reason, that is, temperature, pressure under the dual role of the flange combined with the extruded deformation of the flange, resulting in the paper gasket and its printed on the sealing silicone ring sealing margin is insufficient, resulting in real vehicle durability process occurred in the bad air leakage. The sealing margin of the paper gasket and the silicone ring printed on it was insufficient, resulting in poor air leakage during the endurance process of the actual vehicle. In order to improve the sealing performance of the flange bonding surface, the optimal improvement program was obtained from the flange deformation and sealing interference, which finally solved the problem of air leakage in the real vehicle and ensured the smooth mass production of the model.

articleTitle: Attribute and Struct-Aware Node Mining and Visual Exploration
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: Graph node retrieval is a crucial application, such as identifying compounds with similar properties in a protein network. Traditional methods rely on similarity metrics from graph topology, like graph kernel methods, but neglect vital node attribute information. As network size grows, these methods become computationally costly. To address this, we propose an innovative node retrieval method that seamlessly integrates node topology and attributes using deep learning. This approach is effective in complex system networks, as demonstrated by our developed graph exploration visualization system, validated through a user study confirming its practicality and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Quantitative Measurement of Power Grid Operation Carrying Capacity Based on the Principle of Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: Reasonably quantifying the operating capacity of the power grid can clarify the boundaries of power grid development and allocate resources for power grid investment in a reasonable manner. On the basis of studying the carrying capacity of power grid operation, this article proposes the influencing factors of power grid carrying capacity, including power grid operation efficiency, safety, etc., and clarifies the calculation method of carrying capacity. Based on the principle of fuzzy evaluation, this paper proposes a quantitative model considering the carrying capacity of the power grid, which is used to evaluate the overall operational efficiency and development boundaries of the power grid.

articleTitle: Improving Short-Term Wind Power Forecast Accuracy via an Enhanced SSA-CNN-GRU Hybrid Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: Wind power is increasingly recognized as a crucial source of renewable energy, particularly appealing because it does not require fuel for electricity generation and is thus considered a sustainable option. However, the inherent variability of wind power presents challenges in meeting rising energy demands, especially during peak loads. Accurate forecasting of wind power is essential to address these challenges, given the unpredictable nature and volatility associated with the factors influencing wind turbines and their outputs. In this paper, we introduce a sophisticated wind power prediction model that utilizes a CNN-GRU architecture, enhanced by the integration of a Variational Autoencoder (VAE) and the Sparrow Search Algorithm (SSA). The VAE effectively mitigates data noise, enhancing the quality of the information used for forecasting, while the CNN component extracts critical features from this refined data. The GRU model is then employed to estimate wind power generation. Additionally, the SSA is utilized to autonomously optimize the parameters of the CNN-GRU architecture, ensuring the identification of optimal settings. Our experimental analysis, conducted using actual wind power data, confirms that our proposed model significantly surpasses traditional baseline models in terms of prediction accuracy and stability, achieving an improvement of over 10% in prediction precision. These results not only validate the efficacy of our approach but also highlight its potential applicability in real-world engineering scenarios.

articleTitle: Study on Distribution Characteristics of Power Frequency Exceeding Standard Electric Field of Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: With the continuous expansion of ultra-high voltage lines in China, the design of transmission lines is carried out according to the standard, and the standard does not consider the influence of distorted electric field of buildings, resulting in frequent power frequency electric field exceeding the standard. At present, the way of demolition or erection of shielded wires is mostly used for optimization in engineering construction, but the key factors and improvement methods that cause the electric field to exceed the standard in practical engineering problems are not clear, and the effect of electric field optimization is not good. Based on the above research background, this paper studies the influencing factors of electric field intensity distribution characteristics in the vicinity of buildings around transmission lines, establishes a digital model of electric field of transmission lines, analyzes the distortion law of power frequency electric field by buildings, and puts forward the mechanism of power frequency electric field exceeding the standard of transmission lines to support the design of ultra-high voltage transmission lines.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Loading and Unloading Path Design and Fixture Design for Industrial Robots
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency and precision of CNC machining of parts, Industrial robot automatic loading and unloading technology, automatic sorting technology, and CNC machine tool machining technology are comprehensively applied. Based on the analysis of the machining process of the parts, a reasonable design of the robot’s automatic loading and unloading trajectory and professional pneumatic fixtures has been made, achieving automatic loading and unloading of the processed parts and automatic stacking of the processed products, integrating the robot with CNC machining to meet the automation and unmanned machining process of the parts

articleTitle: Research on Data Governance Strategy Based on Data Center in Power Industry
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: Under the New Normal, Energy Transformation, power system reform, “Big Clond” new technology, making the Traditional power marketing customer service system has been unable to adapt to the increasingly complex user needs. Aiming at the problems of channel business overlapping, business vertical separation of each unit, and service level of common class not intersect, the architecture design of Operation Support platform is studied. On the whole, based on the data center platform, it constructs the whole channel operation support platform architecture including Operation Activities, Operation Channel management, Operation Monitoring and early warning, the deployment mode and business content are also studied. The study results show that the framework covers all aspects of the electricity market and provides support for content operation, activity operation, channel operation and enterprise information management, at the same time also reduces the system’s repeated development and functional overlap.

articleTitle: Research on Development of Multi-Standard Material Management Platform Based on Java
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: With the expansion of the scale and complexity of EPC projects in thermal power plants, the traditional material management method based on tables and material descriptions as identification basis has been difficult to meet the needs of efficient management, and a material management platform based on material coding has emerged. This article describes the method of building a material management platform using Java language in the Windows operating system, which is roughly divided into five parts: material entry, material coding, material association, SPEC establishment, and engineering project application. This paper analyzes three problems existing in the material coding platform, including difficult positioning of multiple codes for material specifications, cumbersome material association operations, and no version records for engineering applications. The corresponding solutions are proposed, and finally, the development plan and logic flow of the multi-rule-based material management platform are clarified.

articleTitle: Research on Classification of Clothing Fabrics Images Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: Clothing fabrics are the material foundation of clothing design. In clothing design, different fabrics are usually used to compare visual effects. But it will take more time and increase material costs. And the choice of fabrics is also quite limited. Digitizing clothing fabrics and automatically categorizing them can solve these problems. The article established a dataset containing 15000 labeled high-definition clothing fabric images belonging to 10 fabric types. Then we use the VGG-16 network model that has been pre-trained on the ImageNet dataset to conduct transfer learning on the fabric images dataset. Finally, by analyzing the experimental results, we found that the VGG-16 model of transfer learning has a strong generalization ability, and its test accuracy in fabric images classification reached 99.73%. The trained convolutional neural network automatic classification model can be applied in digital clothing design, virtual fitting and other aspects. Finally, digital application of clothing fabrics will be achieved.

articleTitle: Blended Learning Behaviors Analysis Based on BP-Bagging Classification Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: To address the challenges of monitoring and analyzing blended learning behaviors, a BP-Bagging ensemble classification model to discriminate students’ blended learning behaviors is proposed. Considering the multiple features and complex interrelationships of blended learning behaviors, the PI algorithm is employed to extract learning behavior features, and the BP neural network is combined with the Bagging algorithm to construct an ensemble model for classifying and discriminating students’ learning behaviors. Experimental results demonstrate that the BP-Bagging ensemble model achieves an accuracy rate of 93.6% in discriminating blended learning behaviors. Compared with other classification models, this ensemble model can improve the generalization performance of individual BP neural network models and has significant practical value.

articleTitle: Several Properties for the Statements of First-order Linear Time-varying Ordinary Differential System with a Algorithm of Parameter Set
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: In this paper, to the first-order linear time-varying ordinary differential systems, the properties of the statements are explored with a parameter algorithm, in which the effect of parameter set on the statements of systems are studied by convex combination of the parameters in parameter set according to the formula for the solution of systems for Caratheodory lemma and Filippov lemma. With the algorithm, two main results are obtained basing on the properties of the parameter sets and Hausdorff metric of points set, one is the statement sets of the system are compact and convex if the parameter sets are compact and not null; the other is statements of the first-ordered linear time-vary ordinary differential systems with parameters are continuous according to the time t in the sense of Hausdorff metric.

Author Keywords: first-ordered linear time-variable ordinary differential system

articleTitle: A study of Camp Security Management Technology Based on Multi-source Information Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: Camps serve as the fundamental locations for regular training, work, and daily living. At present, most camps still rely on manual detection of anomalies, which can lead to false alarms, missed reports, and other issues, resulting in potential threats like equipment loss and personnel disappearances. There is a lack of camp multi-source information fusion and effective emergency response plan generation strategies, making it difficult to fully utilize IoT (Internet of Things) technology for camp security management. This poses a significant bottleneck for camp security development. This study focuses on multi-source information fusion and emergency response plan generation, achieving preliminary high accuracy in camp anomalous behavior discrimination and adaptive emergency response plan creation. It offers a viable solution for integrated security monitoring of equipment, vehicles, personnel, fuel, and other fundamental resources based on IoT technology.

articleTitle: Data analysis and application of the naive Bayesian method in colleges and universities
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: With the development of technology, artificial intelligence and big data have begun to popularize and apply in various fields. To improve the application of data mining in universities, we conducted data analysis on the college entrance examination math scores and university math scores of students from a certain university. We used the Naive Bayes algorithm to model and predict the student data, and ultimately achieved an accuracy rate of over 70%. The results showed that the prediction of university math scores made by Naive Bayes was basically consistent with the actual scores. Through data analysis, we can see that most of the students’ math scores are above 70 points. At the same time, we also analyzed the relationship between gender and performance. The prediction results of this method can be used as a reference for universities and help improve the quality of teaching.

articleTitle: Automatic Control Method of Coal Mine Underground Equipment based on UWB
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: The structure of the electrical system in which multiple equipment in the coal mine excavation face is automatically controlled in the automatic sequence according to the set program, and the structure of the electrical system of the equipment is explained. The wireless ranging sensor based on UWB technology monitors the distance between equipment and equipment and between equipment and coal wall in real time, adopts CAN bus + embedded programming to judge the current equipment status according to the distance, judges and processes the corresponding process through the program, automatically completes the action, realizes the collaborative work between multiple devices, and uses the wireless ranging sensor to realize the collaborative control of multiple equipment, solves the problem of reducing manual operation and reducing work intensity, and improves the safety factor of coal mine production. It is of far-reaching significance to the reduction of coal mine personnel.

articleTitle: Studies on Information Hiding Model Based on Pe File Format
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: Information hiding technology is increasingly prominent in the current informatics research of biology, environment, ecology and other disciplines. Based on the analysis of the characteristics and principles of information hiding technology, this paper proposes an information hiding model based on PE file. In this paper, the hidden information is first encrypted and scrambled by Rijidael, and then hidden by the redundant space in the PE file, and an information hiding scheme based on PE file is proposed, and the security performance of this scheme is preliminarly analyzed, which provides a reference for the future application of this technology to the informatics research of biology, environment, ecology and other disciplines.

articleTitle: Human-computer Interaction Interface Design and Implementation for Locomotive Wiper Test-bed
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: The integration, modularization and intelligentization of the main locomotives such as harmonious locomotive in China railway transportation are getting higher and higher. The wiper of harmonious locomotive is controlled by electricity and wind, which have many parameters to be measured and data to be tested. In this paper, through the analysis of windshield wiper maintenance requirements, the pressure, action test two modes are given, of which the parameters are designed. The control function points are obtained through the study of the working logic of the test equipment. The man-machine interface is set up according to the test parameters and control function by the software of upper microcomputer, and the man-machine interaction function of locomotive wiper tester are realized in nature.

articleTitle: Calibration Method for Power Port of Conductive Immunity System in the Field of Electromagnetic Compatibility
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: Conducted immunity is one of the important items for electromagnetic compatibility immunity testing. In the electromagnetic environment where the simulated product is located, the electromagnetic field generated by the disturbance source acts on the power line, communication line, and internal interconnection lines of the product, thereby An anti-interference evaluation test that affects the working performance of this product through conductive coupling. This article combines examples to analyze the calibration of the conducted immunity test system from the aspects of system construction, parameter setting and result determination. This operation is convenient and can ensure the validity and reproducibility of the calibration results. It is a good reference for relevant laboratories. It provides a technical reference to improve the standardization of the verification method of the conducted immunity test system.

articleTitle: Research on Collaborative Optimization of Power Grid Investment Based on Hybrid Cuckoo Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: In order to adapt to the differentiated development of regions and realize the integration of multiple services in the power grid, a cooperative optimization model of power grid investment is constructed with, taking the maximum investment efficiency and the minimum investment risk as the optimization objectives, and comprehensively considering the factors of power grid investment efficiency, investment risk, and investment carrying capacity. Aiming at the shortcomings of slow convergence speed and poor population diversity in the late evolutionary stage of Cuckoo Search, a hybrid cuckoo algorithm is proposed to solve the problem, which improves the convergence speed and accuracy of the algorithm by referring to the differential evolution algorithm and the quadric interpolation operator. Finally, the superiority of the hybrid Cuckoo Search in solving the grid investment optimization model is verified through typical scenarios and comparison with other algorithms.

articleTitle: Lightweight Fruit and Vegetable Detection Research Based on YOLO-PDMS
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: To reduce the memory footprint and computational requirements of the model, a lightweight model YoLo-PDMS was proposed. It introduced modules named P-ELAN and D-ELAN and replaced the original CIoU with MPDIoU. Network Slimming was utilized to reduce the model size and parameter count. In the final experiment, compared to the original model, parameters decreased by 90.1%, FLOPs reduced by 87.79%, latency decreased by 56.45%, FPS increased by 2.29 times, model size decreased by 77.78%, while MAP50 only decreased by 0.1%.

articleTitle: Research on UAV Cooperative Maritime Situational Awareness Task Planning Based on Improved Markov Process
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: The strong maneuverability and high positioning accuracy of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) make them advantageous for reconnaissance. Therefore, the research and development of UAV-borne radar reconnaissance systems with maritime situational awareness capabilities are of great practical significance. In this paper, we propose an algorithm for task planning of collaborative maritime situational awareness based on improved Markov processes using the optimal search theory. Through quantitative analysis using mathematical models and qualitative analysis combined with actual considerations of target motion patterns and UAV collaboration, we design a maximum discovery probability search model to obtain optimal route planning results under different constraint conditions. The rationality of this method is verified through simulation, providing theoretical support for multi-UAV search for uncertain targets.

articleTitle: Ethereum Phishing Scams Detection: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: The inherent anonymity of blockchain technology has made the cryptocurrency sector a breeding ground for a multitude of illicit financial crimes. In the realm of blockchain transaction security, phishing scams are widely considered a highly severe form of deceit, leading to significant economic losses. This paper provides an overview of past research findings on methods for detecting phishing scam in blockchain networks. Extending graph neural network approaches to detect phishing scam in blockchain networks will be of utmost importance. Graph neural networks yield models with superior generalization capabilities in comparison to conventional approaches. Future research will involve examining high-quality datasets and evaluating the influence of transaction graphs and transaction subgraphs on the effectiveness of detecting phishing scam nodes in categorization. The primary objective is to construct a more resilient model that can achieve the desired detection outcomes and differentiate phishing scams nodes with greater efficiency and precision.

articleTitle: A Novel Hyperspectral Image Band Selection Method: Self-Attention based Reconstruction Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: Hyperspectral image (HSI) consists of hundreds of bands, carrying abundant but redundant information. Band selection (BS) has been proven to be an effective way to reduce the redundancy of HSI. Previous studies have shown that there are correlations between bands. The greater the correlations between one band and others, the more important this band is, which should be prioritized for selection. The self-attention mechanism can automatically discover potential correlations between bands. Therefore, this paper proposes a Self-attention-based Reconstruction Network, named SRN, for band selection. SRN discovers band correlations and generates a band correlation matrix, and then reconstructs HSI based on this. To optimize SRN, the reconstruction error between the original and the reconstructed HSI is used as the loss function. After converges, the band correlation matrix is summed along each row as band weight vector. Then, a special peak-first strategy is implemented to select bands. Experimental results on real HSI datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of SRN.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Rectifier Circuit Based on Improved PSO Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of multiple fault types and low diagnostic accuracy of power electronic circuits, a method of optimizing probabilistic neural network based on wavelet packet decomposition and particle swarm optimization was proposed. Firstly, the simulation model of three-phase bridge rectifier circuit was established, and the fault voltage signal was decomposed and reconstructed by three-layer wavelet packet decomposition technique, and the characteristic values were extracted and normalized. Then PSO was used to optimize the probabilistic neural network to find the appropriate smoothing factor, and the data was trained and diagnosed. Finally, compared with the unoptimized probabilistic neural network, the simulation results show that the method is superior to the unoptimized probabilistic neural network on both training effect and diagnosis accuracy.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Crossword Puzzle Scoring Prediction Models Based on ARIMA, GBDT, and BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: This study utilized ARIMA, GBDT, and BP neural network models to forecast the results of the “World” crossword puzzle game in 2023. By analyzing score data reported by players on Twitter, we investigated the accuracy of different models in predicting the number of word guesses and time. Results indicate that the number of consonants and lexicality have the greatest impact on scores in difficult mode. The ARIMA(1,1,1) model forecasted a result of 14,610 with a confidence interval of [8320,23875], indicating good predictive performance. This study provides a novel approach to forecasting crossword puzzle games and serves as a reference for similar game predictions.

articleTitle: Application Review of Artificial Intelligence in Superconducting Devices
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: Superconducting device has revolutionized various fields, with applications ranging from medical imaging to power transmission. However, further advancements require addressing challenges related to efficiency, reliability, cost, and complexity. Artificial intelligence (AI) offers promising solutions to these challenges, enabling the development of more efficient, reliable, and cost-effective superconducting systems. This paper introduces the recent advances of AI in superconducting device, such as magnetic imaging (MRI), superconducting cable and superconducting motor. Several challenges hinder the widespread adoption of AI in applied superconductivity, such as benchmark models, real-time inference, and community acceptance, are proposed. By addressing these issues, AI’s transformative power will unlock new possibilities, leading to ground-breaking advancements and widespread applications across various fields of superconducting devices.

articleTitle: Application of Voice Navigation System in Assembly Line Workshop Production Work
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: The current silk-making workshop equipment in cigarette factories is relatively large and covers a wide area, and most of them adopt the form of centralized control. It is difficult for operators to pay attention to real-time production conditions and detect production abnormalities in a timely manner. It can easily lead to problems such as safety accidents, process quality accidents, and material loss caused by untimely handling of abnormal shutdowns. To solve these problems, it is necessary to develop a production voice navigation system. By collecting equipment PLC signals and production management system work order information, voice navigation information is formulated, including production rhythm, material logistics, alarm information, etc It can effectively improve operating efficiency and detect production abnormalities early.

articleTitle: Network Traffic Anomaly Detection Based on Port Attention Mechanism and ResNET-BiLSTM-RF
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: In the field of abnormal network traffic detection, traditional deep learning-based methods have not separately considered the role of port numbers in network traffic. In order to enhance the efficiency of abnormal network traffic detection, a network traffic anomaly detection model combining attention mechanism is proposed, which includes Port Attention Mechanism (PAM) and ResNET-BiLSTM-RF. Firstly, the original network traffic is input into the port attention module to separate the port number attribute. The weight values of port attention are then utilized to filter out other important features, outputting the traffic attributes of port attention. Subsequently, the other traffic attributes are input into the deep learning network model of ResNET- BiLSTM-RF. In the first stage, a residual network (ResNET) is employed for binary classification to distinguish benign traffic from attack traffic. In the second stage, attack traffic is input into BiLSTM and random forest for multi-class decision making. This model has been experimentally validated to achieve high accuracy on the CICIDS-2017 data set.

articleTitle: Grass-Roots-Oriented Data Application Services: Requirements Analysis and Solutions
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: with the progress of society, Science and technology, more and more people have realized the importance of smart grid construction and the application of the Internet of things Big data on electricity, which includes both structured and unstructured data, is now bigger than structured data because of Unstructured data growth. In this paper, from the internal and external application value of the Lo aspects and demand analysis of power big data conducted in-depth study for the future development of reference.

articleTitle: BGRAFT: Grouped Anti-Byzantine RAFT Consensus Algorithm Based on RSA Encryption Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: To solve the low performance of PBFT algorithm in large-scale networks in the consortium blockchain and RAFT algorithm cannot cope with the Byzantine problem, cannot exclude malicious nodes, and lack of security guarantee for node communication, this paper proposes the BGRAFT (Byzantine Fault Tolerance Grouped RAFT) consensus algorithm. The algorithm divides the network into small-sized network groups by dynamic network grouping and uses PBFT consensus within the group and RAFT consensus between the groups. At the same time, RSA signature encryption algorithm is introduced to guarantee the privacy and security of inter-node communication. It is shown that BGRAFT has Byzantine fault-tolerant characteristics in large-scale networks, while maintaining high consensus efficiency and scalability, which is better than PBFT, and can achieve 100% message tampering detection rate.

articleTitle: Research on Deep Learning-Based Human Skin Quality Assessment Method
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: Skin quality detection is crucial for personal daily care, among other things. Correct skincare relies on accurate and quantifiable complexion assessment as a foundation. However, there are currently no products for skin quality detection available on the market. This study explores facial complexion assessment methods based on deep learning. Leveraging the DeepLab v3 neural network and enhanced attention mechanisms within a multiscale receptive field, various human skin characteristics can be identified more accurately. This, in turn, enables quantified scoring of skin quality. Future skin assessment devices utilizing this algorithm could have promising market prospects, particularly in medical aesthetics.

articleTitle: Construction of Intelligent Recommendation System for Impromptu Singing by Using Database Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: In today’s era of rapid development of Internet technology, people not only enjoy the convenience brought by science and technology, but also need to take the initiative to understand and learn what is happening around them. As a new type of song form, improvisation has been loved and sought after by the vast number of music lovers. This paper will focus on how to use database system to develop an impromptu singing intelligent recommendation system based on database algorithm, which is of great significance to improve the piano singing level and meet the needs of consumers. After constructing the impromptu intelligent recommendation system, the performance of the system is tested. The test results show that the time delay of each impromptu singing is 0.5 s, 0.7 s, 0.8 s, 0.6 s, 0.9 s, 0.4 s, 0.7 s and 0.6 s, respectively. The value of the delay time varied between different participants, ranging from 0.4 to 0.9 seconds, showing the varying degrees of delay encountered during the live singing. Through a large number of research tests and analytical studies, the practical value of this method is increasingly recognized, so it is well worth exploring and practicing it.

articleTitle: Development and Application of an Intelligent Clash Check and Handling System Based on PDMS Plant Design Software
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: This paper proposes an intelligent clash check and handling system tailored for the 3D design software PDMS in the power industry, aiming to enhance its clash check capabilities. The system comprises multiple modules, including clash check configuration, scheduled and real-time clash checks, data storage, data retrieval, and processing modules. It allows users to set clash check times and objects based on design progress, perform clash checks automatically or manually, and store the results. Additionally, it utilizes algorithms to avoid redundant processing of clash data. Designers can retrieve and view clash data, formulate handling plans, and input the results, providing support for data traceability and design review. The application of this system will improve the functional integrity of the PDMS software in terms of clash check, providing an efficient tool for digital design in the power industry.

articleTitle: Research on Text Categorization Based on Natural Language Processing and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: This article aims to study the process of automatic text classification, with a focus on two key steps: feature extraction and classification processing. By adopting suitable feature extraction methods and classification processing models, the accuracy and efficiency of automatic text classification can be improved. The effectiveness of the proposed methods is verified through experiments and evaluations, and a corresponding result evaluation model is proposed to measure the classification performance. The research findings indicate that selecting appropriate feature extraction methods and classification processing models can enhance the accuracy and effectiveness of text classification. In the conclusion section, the research achievements of this article are summarized, and directions and prospects for future research are pointed out. This study provides a complete process for automatic text classification, which is of great guidance significance for practical applications.

articleTitle: Design of Efficient Financial Big Data Processing and Analysis System Using Machine Learning Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: In order to assist quantitative analysis models in quantitatively predicting and controlling risks through an effective credit scoring system, the author proposes using machine learning technology for an efficient financial big data processing and analysis system. In response to the shortcomings of using logistic regression to measure risk in the context of big data, based on the online cash loan data of a consumer finance company in 2017 and 2018, the XGBoost machine learning algorithm was used to establish a model, which was compared and analyzed with the model established by logistic regression. Based on this, a Stacking model was established, aiming to achieve better model performance. The results showed that the ROC curve, AUC value, and KS value of the sample data training set were 0.8707 and 0.514, respectively; Figure 3 shows the ROC curve, AUC value, and KS value of the test set, with an AUC of 0.8554 and KS of 0.5877. Conclusion: The model performance of XGBoost is better than logistic regression and slightly better than that of GBDT.

articleTitle: Unmanned Aerial Vehicle 3D Path Planning Based on Improved Nonlinear Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: When executing a mission, an Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) must rely on three-dimensional path planning to avoid obstacles. Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) is suitable for the path planning problem because of few parameters, fast convergence and easy implementation. However, along with the dynamic change of the search path, the particle diversity tends to be singularity, and also the population easily fall into the local optimal region. In this regard, An Improved Nonlinear Particle Swarm Optimization (INPSO) Algorithm is proposed for UAV 3D path planning. This algorithm introduces the Sugeno function to construct nonlinear inertia weights and learning factors for enhancing the global search capability of the particle population. At the same time, INPSO incorporates a reverse learning elimination mechanism based on the wolf predation strategy to update the poorly adapted particles in the late iteration, so as to regulate the particle population diversity and enhance the optimal seeking and convergence performance of the algorithm. Simulation tests show that compared with other algorithms, INPSO not only achieves the shortest average path, but also obtains a higher effective path rate in complex terrain environments, and has better convergence speed and search accuracy.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of an Education Management Information System Based on J2EE
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: In order to meet the needs of educational management in vocational colleges and make daily educational management more effective and convenient, the author proposes an education management information system based on J2EE. Integrating the system’s functions from the user’s perspective and dividing the system into teacher end, student end, and administrator end can optimize the internal organization of the system and improve the user experience. In the selection of technical solutions for the system, the author adopts the SSH framework and combines the ideas provided by MVC, Ajax technology, MyEclipse, UML, SOA, workflow and other technologies to design the overall structure and database pattern of the system. In terms of system implementation and testing, the focus is on analyzing and designing how to specifically implement the scheduling algorithm in the teaching operation management module. The findings reveal a robust performance, with no instances of crashing errors detected throughout the testing phase. However, attention was directed towards certain functional points, particularly in the implementation and interface performance, where other errors were concentrated. These issues were successfully addressed and resolved during the testing period. Under optimal network conditions and with a simulated load of fewer than 1200 users, the system exhibited commendable performance. The average response time for a single transaction remained under 1 second, and all transactions were successfully completed. Nevertheless, as the user load increased to 1600, there was a noticeable rise in system transaction response time, leading to transaction failures and a subsequent decline in the success rate. Despite these challenges under higher user loads, the educational management system demonstrated excellent interactivity and, on the whole, successfully achieved its design objectives. It stands poised to meet the diverse requirements of daily educational management.

articleTitle: A Novel Image Segmentation Based on Pixel Probability Measurement Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: Natural image segmentation is an important Held in image and computer vision processing. Custer-based image segmentation algorithm, which is the main method of the unsupervised image segmentation algorithm is the most widely used segmentation method. However, these methods generally use pixel-based feature extraction, which directly leads to a poor fit between the segmentation result and the boundary. To mitigate this problem, the paper proposes a serialized processing process for image segmentation. It uses multiple clues such as the brightness and texture of image pixels. A sequence of image pixel regions with merge processing steps has been designed. They gradually generate segment-able regions. In each step of the process, probability metrics have been used to quantitatively analyze the similarity of feature clues in adjacent regions. This determines whether they belong to the same segmented region or not. The image brightness and texture distribution of each area and the surrounding local area is the main clue combination of the probability formula that has been designed. The geometric shape of the area is another important clue of a priori design. At the end of the algorithm, the combined posterior of the mixed expert formula has been designed through feature clues such as brightness and texture. Combining this probability measurement method, a complete image-level segmentation algorithm is formed. Its complexity is only affected by the number of image pixels, and the relationship is linear. Almost no intervention is needed to adjust the parameter values during the execution of the algorithm. At the end of the article, the experimental results on the custom test data set (collected from the standard data set) show that the algorithm solves the above existing problems and has achieved good experimental results.

articleTitle: A Climate Change Prediction System Based on Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology (ICAIDT)
abstract: In order to improve the precision of traditional methods, we propose a climate change forecasting system based on machine learning. Based on the analysis of the historical return data from the BCC-CSM Seasonal Climate Forecast System and the National Meteorological Information Center of China, a variety of methods have been used to examine the various factors affecting the forecast results. The Long Short Term Memory (LSTM) network is used to predict Chinese summer rainfall in 2020 and 2021. The results show that the LSTM network performs better than the BP neural network and the model output method. In particular, the performance of LSTM networks has been greatly affected by parameter optimization, including the training rate, and the learning rate. The selection of appropriate starting month data in particular enhances seasonal forecasting accuracy, with April data proving particularly effective for predicting summer precipitation. Additionally, incorporating the sea ice component factor positively contributes to seasonal precipitation prediction. In 2021 and 2022 summer precipitation return experiments, the LSTM network showed remarkable prediction performance, achieving 74 and 71 Ps, and 55.52% for anomaly symbols, respectively. The results exceed, on average, the results of national consultations and business models over the same period. In conclusion, the LSTM network offers improved prediction accuracy compared to traditional methods, presenting a promising avenue for enhancing seasonal precipitation forecasting.
